description: Rosanna Gabaldón has served in the State Senate since 2020 and as an Arizona State Representative from 2013 to 2021, in addition to three years on the Sahuarita Town Council. Known for collaborating with local stakeholders, school boards, and businesses, Rosanna has focused on growth and public education. She is passionate about protecting Arizona's environment and advocating for its most vulnerable. She champions water sustainability, public education, and economic development.
title: Rosanna Gabaldón for Arizona State Senate | Water Sustainability, Public Education, Economic Development
